questions.text:
In the given question, a sentence is given with a part of it missing and represented by a blank. Choose the phrase that can be placed in the given blank to make a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence.

Trade unionists feared that telework was just __________employers to cut wage bills and erode workers’ rights.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e. another ploy by.

  • The given sentence speaks about the thought of trade unionists regarding telework.
  • Option 1) cannot be chosen here because it is not making the sentence meaningful.
  • Option 2) cannot be used.The meaning of the word revenge is to harm others and it is not suitable.
  • Option 3) is not suitable for the sentence.
  • Option 4) is the best fit.The word ploy means tactic or move (something that is done or said in order to get an advantage) and it is suitable for the sentence.

 

Hence, option 4) is the answer.

questions.text:
In the given question, a sentence is given with a part of it missing and represented by a blank. Choose the phrase that can be placed in the given blank to make a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence.

Our community __________, making big and small sacrifices for the greater good.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is option 3), i.e. has come together.

Key Points

  • The given sentence states the action taken by the community for the greater good.
  • Option 1) cannot be chosen. The word assembled means flock together / to bring together (as in a particular place or for a particular purpose) and it is not making the sentence meaningful.
  • Option 2) and option 4) cannot be chosen because these are not suitable for the sentence.
  • Option 3) is the best fit. It means helping each other or standing by each other and this is suitable for the sentence.

 

Hence, option 3) is the answer.

questions.text:
In the given question, a sentence is given with a part of it missing and represented by a blank. Choose the phrase that can be placed in the given blank to make a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence.

Cultural diversity itself __________resilience and adaptability to change.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e. is a source of.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is about cultural diversity.
  • Option 1) cannot be chosen because it cannot be called a method.
  • Option 2) is the best fit because it can be called the source of adaptability and flexibility to changes.
  • Option 3) is not relevant so it cannot be chosen.
  • Option 4) is not the answer.The word bleak means bare / gloomy / without hope and it is not suitable for the sentence.
     

Hence option 2) is the answer.

questions.text:
In the given question, a sentence is given with a part of it missing and represented by a blank. Choose the phrase that can be placed in the given blank to make a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence.

International law allows many of our freedoms __________ in response to a public health emergency.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e. to be restricted.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is about international laws which may be enforced at the time of emergency.
  • Option 1) cannot be the answer. The word emancipated means "liberated / the process of giving people social or political freedom and rights" and it is not making the sentence meaningful.
  • Option 2) and option 3) are not relevant.
  • Option 4) is the best fit because at the time of emergency, laws may be enforced for restriction.
  • Hence, option 4) is the answer.

Correct Sentence : "International law allows many of our freedoms to be restricted in response to a public health emergency."

questions.text:
Directions: In a question given below an incomplete sentence that must be filled/ completed with one of the sentences/phrases given below i.e. one of the sentences/phrases can be fit into the given blanks. Choose the correct option and complete the given sentences.

There is no doubt that the concerns of the affected people should be addressed,_______________________________ destruction of nature.

options.text: but its should be done in a way that doesn’t lead to further
but it should be done in a way that doesn’t lead to further
but it should not be done in it way that doesn’t lead to further
but it's should be done in a way that doesn’t lead to further
but it should be done in a way that doesn’t lead for further

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is "but it should be done in a way that doesn’t lead to further."

Key Points

  • Let us see each option:
    • Option 1: but its should be done in a way that doesn’t lead to further.
      • Here the usage of its is wrong.
      • It should be 'it'.
      • 'Its' is a possessive determiner, use to say that something belongs to or refers to something.
    • Option 3:  but it should not be done in it way that doesn’t lead to further.
      • It should be "It" should be done in a way.
      • Since 'it' is used incorrectly here and makes the sentence incorrect.
      • Option 3 will automatically be eliminated.
    • Option 4:  but it's should be done in a way that doesn’t lead to further.
      • Here ''it's'' is making the sentence incorrect.
      • "It's" is short for 'it is' or 'it has'.   
      • Example-
        • It's raining It's been raining since last night.
    • Option 5:  but it should be done in a way that doesn’t lead for further.
      • Here, the preposition "for'' is making the sentence incorrect.
      • 'to' will be used instead of 'for.'
  • Thus the correct option is 2 with all the correct prepositions and determiners.

questions.text:
Directions: In a question given below an incomplete sentence that must be filled/completed with one of the sentences/phrases given below i.e. one of the sentences/phrases can be fit into the given blanks. Choose the correct option and complete the given sentence.

The other glaring deficiency ____________________________ or permitting them an opportunity to present their defence.

options.text: is the complete absence of any prior show-cause notice by the actual users of these accounts by the government,
is the complete absence yet any prior show-cause notice to the actual users of these accounts by the government,
is the complete absence of any prior show-cause notice to the actual users of these accounts by the government,
are the complete absence of any prior show-cause notice to the actual users of these accounts by the government,
is the complete absence of any prior show-cause notice to the actual users by these accounts by the government,

questions.explanation:
The correct answer is 'is the complete absence of any prior show-cause notice to the actual users of these accounts.'

Key Points

  • Let's see the grammatical structure of the sentence:
    • The subject of the sentence i.e. 'the other glaring deficiency' is a phrasal noun and is singular, therefore, the verb that is required is singular i.e. 'is'.
    • Prior is an adjective which takes 'to' as its fixed preposition.
    • Of as a preposition means belonging or relating to something or somebody. In this sentence, it is showing the relation of complete absence with show-cause notice.
    • By as a preposition identifies the agent performing the action and the agent of performing the action is the government.

Thus, the correct answer is-The other glaring deficiency is the complete absence of any prior show-cause notice to the actual users of these accounts by the government, or permitting them an opportunity to present their defence. 

Additional Information

  • In statement 1, preposition by is used twice. It is used to show the relation between show-cause notice and actual users also in between accounts and the government. By as a preposition identifies the agent performing the action. Therefore, one of the usages of by is incorrect. 
  • In statement 2,  preposition yet is used to show the relationship between complete absence and show-cause notice. Yet can be used as a conjunction or adverb. As a conjunction, it is used to show contrast and as an adverb, it used to show specified or implied time. With the context of this sentence, there is no implied time or contrast therefore the usage of yet here is incorrect.
  • In statement 4, the subject of the sentence i.e. 'The other glaring deficiency' is a  phrasal noun and singular, therefore, the usage of the verb 'are' is incorrect.
  • In statement 5.  preposition by is used twice. It is used to show the relation between actual users and accounts also in between accounts and the government. By as a preposition identifies the agent performing the action. Therefore, one of the usages of by is incorrect. 
  • Thus, Statement 3 is the only statement which fits the blank.

questions.text:
In the given question, a sentence is given with a part of it missing and represented by a blank. Choose the phrase that can be placed in the given blank to make a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence.

People in lower socioeconomic groups __________ to go out to work during lockdown.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e. may feel more pressure.

  • The given sentence is about the condition of lower socioeconomic groups.
  • Option 1) cannot be chosen. The meaning of the word exhausted is tired and it is not making the sentence meaningful.
  • Option 2) is the best fit. The lower socioeconomic groups may feel pressure to go out to work and it is suitable.
  • Option 3) cannot be chosen. The meaning of the word infuriated means enraged / to make someone angry and it is not suitable for this sentence.
  • Option 4) cannot be chosen. The meaning of the word annoyed is irritated and it is not the best fit.

 

Hence, option 2) is the answer.

questions.text:
In the given question, a sentence is given with a part of it missing and represented by a blank. Choose the phrase that can be placed in the given blank to make a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence.

The ease with which data sharing has occurred in the pandemic might signal __________.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is option 4), i.e. a shift in perceptions.

  • The unique way of data sharing is discussed in this sentence.
  • Option 1) cannot be chosen because it is not making the sentence meaningful and complete.
  • Option 2) cannot be chosen because the method of data sharing has nothing to do with education.
  • Option 3) cannot be chosen because only this method cannot hint at the development of science.
  • Option 4) is the best fit. The word perception means awareness and this is suitable for this sentence.

 

Hence, option 4) is the answer.

questions.text:
In the given question, a sentence is given with a part of it missing and represented by a blank. Choose the phrase that can be placed in the given blank to make a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence.

In the short term, both in the UK and elsewhere, __________ than letting people resume their lives, once it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is there is nothing more desirable.

Key Points

  • The given sentence is about what is more important for the time being at different places.
  • Option 1) is the best fit because nothing is more important than letting people resume their lives.
  • Option 2) cannot be chosen because it is not making the sentence grammatically correct.
  • Option 3) and option 4) are not suitable for the given sentence.

 

Hence, option 1) is the answer.

questions.text:
In the given question, a sentence is given with a part of it missing and represented by a blank. Choose the phrase that can be placed in the given blank to make a meaningful and grammatically correct sentence.

The brakes placed on economic activities of many kinds, worldwide, __________carbon emission cuts that would previously have been unthinkable.
questions.explanation:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e. have led to.

  • The given sentence is about how the sudden brake on certain activities have decreased carbon emission.
  • Option 1) cannot be chosen.The word loitered means hang around aimlessly / to act slowly or with leisure and it is not making the sentence meaningful.
  • Option 2) is the best fit. Lead to means to make something happen or to cause something and it is suitable for the sentence.
  • Option 3) cannot be chosen.The phrase cluttered up means to mess up / to fill something or some place up with too many things and it is not relevant.
  • Option 4) cannot be chosen.The word venerated means respected and it is not suitable for the sentence.

 

Hence, option 2) is the answer.
